information.description:
The lowest bottom-feeder of Arasaka’s security details is the humble security guard. They defend corporate interests all across the globe, with gear and armor only slightly better than what you can get on the street. Still, they’re just the fodder before the real threats show up, so make sure they don’t call on their friends.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Arasaka).

description.value: Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

One of the oldest weapons made by Arasaka from the early 2000s. These days it's a rare sight on the street, as it's a pistol that is — no point in sugarcoating it — outdated and difficult to maintain. Spare parts for it are no longer manufactured, and it's no longer compatible with most standard weapon mods. That being said, should it be held up to someone's head and have its trigger is pulled, the end result will still be as conclusive as with any modern firearm.

Cost: 100eb (Premium)

Class: Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: Armor-Piercing Ammunition bought for this weapon costs 20eb (Everyday) per 10, and can only be used by this weapon.

Range: Pistol

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
An Exotic, One-handed Medium Melee Weapon. Target is knocked unconscious if damage dealt would reduce them to under 1 HP. Doesn't cause Critical Injuries or ablate armor.
Simple Leather armor for your head. No armor penalty.
Deals no damage. If hit roll DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs. On a fail take the Damaged Eye and Damaged Ear Critical injuries (see pg. 188) for 1 minute. No Crit damage dealt.
